question: What structural division of teachings is sought to be fully known?
premises: There exists a division of eight octads
The speaker seeks to know this division fully
The knowing is desired in an endless or complete manner
inference: The speaker seeks to fully and endlessly know the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: And to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
